acquisition method: The column outlet was coupled directly to the ion source of the Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Electron Corp., San Jose, CA, USA) working in the regime of data-dependent MS to MS/MS switch.
alkylation reagent: blocked with 200 mM MMTS (10mM) for 10 min at room temperature
alkylation concentration: blocked with 200 mM MMTS (10mM) for 10 min at room temperature
cleavage agent: Protein solutions were subjected to the standard procedure of trypsin digestion
fragmentation method: The rest of the search parameters were as follows: enzyme: trypsin; missed cleavages: 1; instrument: HCD.
instrument: The column outlet was coupled directly to the ion source of the Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Electron Corp., San Jose, CA, USA) working in the regime of data-dependent MS to MS/MS switch.
labeling: The resulting peptide mixtures were applied in equal volumes of 20 µl to the RP-18 pre-column
precursor tolerance: Peptide mass tolerance and fragment mass tolerance were set as ± 5 ppm and ± 0.01 Da, respectively.
fragment tolerance: Peptide mass tolerance and fragment mass tolerance were set as ± 5 ppm and ± 0.01 Da, respectively.
ptm: Methylothiolation (C) was set as a fixed modification and oxidation (M) as a variable modification.
reduction reagent: proteins were reduced with 0.5 M (5 mM) TCEP for 1 h at 60 °C
reduction concentration: proteins were reduced with 0.5 M (5 mM) TCEP for 1 h at 60 °C
